subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-party memory-core operator facade for remember/recall/review/edit/forget, or leave this capability to external memory plugins until the canonical Memory MVP contracts land?
rationale: The requested commands define durable memory lifecycle, provenance, and plugin-slot semantics rather than wiring existing memory-core commands together.

options.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface anchor and require maintainer approval after the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge.

options.title: Prototype Externally First
options.body: Use memory-lancedb, Engram-style tooling, or another ClawHub package to validate the workflow until OpenClaw exposes any missing generic seams.

options.title: Reject First-Party Facade
options.body: Close the first-party operator facade if maintainers decide write/review/forget commands should not be a default OpenClaw product surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface anchor and require maintainer approval after the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current memory-core CLI/docs and VISION history make vincentkoc the best available owner for the memory product-surface decision.
